answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents mint stake-tied cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Validating each node consumes rare jade tokens, and each cloned identity must stake compounding reserves—turning an isolated swarm island into an exponential capital exhaustion sink where funding dry runs like pigment. Attacker costs grow superlinearly as $O(2^n)$ collateral requirements bankrupt replicated entities.
